status.title: Who can vote for the Knesset, by legal status

rows.label: Israeli citizens 18 and over living in Israel, among them Palestinian citizens of Israel and Druze citizens
Israeli citizens living in West Bank settlements
cells: Yes, at polling stations in their own localities

rows.label: Israeli citizens abroad
cells: Only in Israel on election day, except official government and Jewish Agency emissaries

rows.label: East Jerusalem Palestinians with permanent residency
West Bank Palestinians
cells: Palestinian Authority national and local elections

rows.label: Gaza Palestinians
cells: Palestinian Authority elections; Hamas has ruled Gaza since 2007

status.question: Legal status decides the Knesset vote: citizenship, not residence or the territory a person lives in.
status.source: Inter-Agency Task Force on Israeli Arab Issues; Central Elections Committee; Israel Democracy Institute
status.note: Palestinian Authority national elections were last held in 2005 (presidency) and 2006 (legislature); local elections were held in April 2026, and a legislative vote is set for November 28, 2026. See the Palestinian elections section.
